question: Where is the nearest gallery along the corridor from University Spine Center, Wayne, NJ to NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.226965 40.929521)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.995715 40.728699)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE tourism = 'gallery'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.226965 40.929521)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.226965 40.929521)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[3].display_name: NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences, New York, NY

poi.poi_name: NYU Courant Institute of Mathematical Sciences
